sv.title: CVC gör exit i Cary Group – Nordic Capital får sällskap av två nya storägare
sv.summary: Riskkapitalbolaget CVC säljer sin halva av det sedan några år tillbaka onoterade bilglasbolaget Cary Group. Två nya storägare kliver in samtidigt som Nordic Capital återinvesterar i bolaget. Vd Anders Jensen gör sin femte exit i bolaget.

en.title: CVC exits Cary Group – Nordic Capital gets two new major owners
en.summary: The risk capital firm CVC is selling its half of the car-glass company Cary Group, which has been unlisted for a few years. Two new major owners are stepping in as Nordic Capital reinvests in the company. CEO Anders Jensen is making his fifth exit from the company.
